## Overview

Part of the [**Data Science Projects Collection**](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-) (Condo rent price predicition in Phnom Penh)—Predicts monthly condo rental rates in Phnom Penh from property and neighborhood features.

## Problem & Data

Renters and landlords need accurate rent benchmarks in a fast-moving Phnom Penh rental market.

## Approach

Scrape rental listings, encode location and unit features, train regression models, validate with MAE/RMSE.

## Technologies

Python · pandas · scikit-learn · Jupyter

## Outcomes

Rent estimates with sensitivity to district, size, and furnishing factors.
